upstream.name: sqlite/sqlite
upstream.architecture: SQLite database file format, b-tree pages, records, varints, journaling, SQL engine, extensions, and TCL/C regression harnesses.

benchmarkDenominator.source: Shallow blobless GitHub mirror clone at .upstream-cache/libsqlite; initially inspected as a root-only sparse checkout, then hydrated only the SQLite build/test directories needed for configure, testfixture, and Tcl runner execution: src, test, tool, ext, autosetup, autoconf, and mptest.

prerequisitesInstalled: sudo -n dnf install -y tcl tcl-devel gcc make

cacheHydration.before: .upstream-cache/libsqlite was a clean shallow blobless Git checkout at 8f70ec615f4cd247d36f92a22c99f65ebbcc22a7 with a root-only sparse checkout.
cacheHydration.command: git -C .upstream-cache/libsqlite sparse-checkout set src test tool ext autosetup autoconf mptest
cacheHydration.after: SQLite source, test, tool, extension, autosetup/autoconf, and mptest directories were materialized; the upstream worktree remained clean.

nativeImplementation.currentSlice: Native SQLite database header parser, SQLite varint decoder/encoder, SQLite record decoder/encoder, table leaf cell encoder, table leaf page assembler, b-tree page header parser, table leaf and table interior cell parsers, index leaf and index interior cell parsers, database page reader, sqlite_schema table-b-tree traversal, bounded table-row decoding, rowid table lookup, standard wp_options option_name/option_value reads from resolved root pages, table leaf overflow payload chain reads for large records, explicit/automatic index-assisted wp_options recovery paths, built-in and supplied custom collation comparisons, partial-index implication checks, composite equality-prefix/range scans, lower/upper/trim/substr/length/CAST/JSON expression-index lookup families, supported JSON5 and focused SQLite JSONB verification/generation/type/array-length/remove/insert/set/replace/array-insert/merge-patch behavior, bounded seek traversal for range/IN-list/composite/expression scans, read-only sqlite_sequence AUTOINCREMENT record inspection, bounded SQLiteAutoincrementState allocation/update semantics, b-tree page freeblock/free-space accounting inspection with corrupt chain rejection, and WordPress fixture/preflight helpers for generated wp_options record payloads, table leaf cells, and table leaf pages.

wordpressScenario: SQLite fallback/read/write inspection tooling for WordPress hosts where the SQLite extension is unavailable, now including bounded wp_options row inspection, large option_value overflow reads, explicit and automatic index-backed option lookups, callback-backed custom-collation point/range and equality-prefix recovery paths, expression-index recovery for lower/upper/trim/substr/length/CAST/json_extract/JSON ->>/JSON -> paths, JSON5 and JSONB option-value verification and focused JSONB mutation/preflight helpers, bounded index traversal that avoids unrelated or damaged branches, native varint and record serialization preflight for generated wp_options payloads, table-leaf cell/page assembly for minimal fixture generation or repair planning, sqlite_sequence AUTOINCREMENT counter inspection, native next-ID/explicit-import sequence state for WordPress ID continuity checks, and b-tree page freeblock/free-space inspection for page-local WordPress database recovery diagnostics.
